diff --git a/durability.go b/durability.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..fb4a9efe
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability.go
@@ -0,0 +1,464 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"container/heap"
+	"context"
+	"math"
+	"slices"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/crlib/crtime"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+)
+
+// ErrDurabilityJobExpired is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the
+// provided job ID belonged to a BatchDurable event that has fallen outside the
+// bounded retention window.
+var ErrDurabilityJobExpired = errors.New("pebble: durability job expired")
+
+// ErrDurabilityJobUnknown is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the
+// provided job ID was never assigned to a BatchDurable event.
+var ErrDurabilityJobUnknown = errors.New("pebble: unknown durability job")
+
+// ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions is delivered on the channel returned by
+// DB.DurabilityNotify when the number of outstanding subscriptions exceeds
+// the limit.
+var ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions = errors.New("pebble: too many outstanding durability subscriptions")
+
+const (
+	// durabilityJobRetention is the number of most recent BatchDurable job
+	// results retained for DB.WaitForJobDurability.
+	durabilityJobRetention = 1024
+	// maxDurabilityNotifySubscriptions bounds the number of outstanding
+	// DB.DurabilityNotify subscriptions.
+	maxDurabilityNotifySubscriptions = 1024
+)
+
+// DurabilityStats is a snapshot of the state of the DB's durability tracking.
+// See DB.DurabilityStats.
+type DurabilityStats struct {
+	// HighestDurableSeqNum is the highest sequence number known to be durable
+	// as a result of a Sync commit.
+	HighestDurableSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	// FirstErr is the first WAL sync error observed by a Sync commit.
+	FirstErr error
+	// PendingWaiters is the number of goroutines currently blocked in the
+	// durability wait APIs.
+	PendingWaiters int64
+	// TotalDurableCommits is the number of Sync commits that became durable.
+	TotalDurableCommits uint64
+	// TotalFailedCommits is the number of Sync commits whose WAL sync failed.
+	TotalFailedCommits uint64
+	// CumulativeSyncDuration is the cumulative WAL sync phase duration of
+	// durable Sync commits.
+	CumulativeSyncDuration time.Duration
+	// MaxSyncDuration is the maximum WAL sync phase duration of a durable Sync
+	// commit.
+	MaxSyncDuration time.Duration
+}
+
+// batchDurableState is the per-batch state used to report the durability of
+// a Sync commit.
+type batchDurableState struct {
+	// db is set when a Sync commit performed via ApplyNoSyncWait is awaiting
+	// Batch.SyncWait to report its durability.
+	db            *DB
+	seqNum        base.SeqNum
+	count         uint32
+	size          int
+	correlationID uint64
+	// walWritten is the time at which the batch was written to the WAL (at
+	// which point the WAL sync is pending).
+	walWritten    crtime.Mono
+	applyDuration time.Duration
+}
+
+// durabilityWaiter is a pending wait for a sequence number to become durable.
+type durabilityWaiter struct {
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	// ch is buffered with capacity 1 and receives exactly one value.
+	ch chan error
+	// notify is true for DurabilityNotify subscriptions.
+	notify bool
+	// index is the waiter's index in the heap, or -1 once it has been removed.
+	index int
+}
+
+type durabilityWaiterHeap []*durabilityWaiter
+
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Len() int           { return len(h) }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Less(i, j int) bool { return h[i].seqNum < h[j].seqNum }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Swap(i, j int) {
+	h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i]
+	h[i].index = i
+	h[j].index = j
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Push(x any) {
+	w := x.(*durabilityWaiter)
+	w.index = len(*h)
+	*h = append(*h, w)
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Pop() any {
+	old := *h
+	n := len(old)
+	w := old[n-1]
+	old[n-1] = nil
+	w.index = -1
+	*h = old[:n-1]
+	return w
+}
+
+// durabilityTracker tracks the durability of Sync commits. The zero value is
+// ready for use.
+type durabilityTracker struct {
+	pendingWaiters atomic.Int64
+
+	mu struct {
+		sync.Mutex
+		durable  base.SeqNum
+		firstErr error
+		closeErr error
+		waiters  durabilityWaiterHeap
+		// notifySubs is the number of outstanding DurabilityNotify
+		// subscriptions in waiters.
+		notifySubs int
+
+		totalDurable uint64
+		totalFailed  uint64
+		cumSync      time.Duration
+		maxSync      time.Duration
+
+		// Metrics accumulated only when EventListener.BatchDurable is
+		// configured.
+		metricsCount    uint64
+		metricsDuration time.Duration
+
+		jobs struct {
+			results map[JobID]error
+			// ring holds the retained job IDs in FIFO order.
+			ring []JobID
+			head int
+			// first is the first job ID ever recorded.
+			first JobID
+			// maxEvicted is the largest job ID evicted from the retention
+			// window, or zero if none have been evicted.
+			maxEvicted JobID
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// resultLocked returns the outcome of waiting for seqNum if it is already
+// determined.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) resultLocked(seqNum base.SeqNum) (err error, done bool) {
+	switch {
+	case seqNum <= t.mu.durable:
+		return nil, true
+	case t.mu.firstErr != nil:
+		return t.mu.firstErr, true
+	case t.mu.closeErr != nil:
+		return t.mu.closeErr, true
+	}
+	return nil, false
+}
+
+// releaseLocked delivers err to a waiter that has been removed from the heap.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) releaseLocked(w *durabilityWaiter, err error) {
+	if w.notify {
+		t.mu.notifySubs--
+	}
+	w.ch <- err
+}
+
+// failAllLocked removes every waiter, delivering err to each.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) failAllLocked(err error) {
+	for t.mu.waiters.Len() > 0 {
+		t.releaseLocked(heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter), err)
+	}
+}
+
+// record records the outcome of a Sync commit whose highest sequence number is
+// lastSeqNum.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) record(
+	lastSeqNum base.SeqNum, err error, syncDuration time.Duration, accumulateMetrics bool,
+) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.mu.totalFailed++
+		if t.mu.firstErr == nil {
+			t.mu.firstErr = err
+		}
+		t.failAllLocked(t.mu.firstErr)
+		return
+	}
+	t.mu.totalDurable++
+	t.mu.cumSync += syncDuration
+	t.mu.maxSync = max(t.mu.maxSync, syncDuration)
+	if accumulateMetrics {
+		t.mu.metricsCount++
+		t.mu.metricsDuration += syncDuration
+	}
+	// The WAL is synced in order, so the durability of this batch implies the
+	// durability of every preceding sequence number.
+	if lastSeqNum > t.mu.durable {
+		t.mu.durable = lastSeqNum
+	}
+	for t.mu.waiters.Len() > 0 && t.mu.waiters[0].seqNum <= t.mu.durable {
+		t.releaseLocked(heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter), nil)
+	}
+}
+
+// recordJob records the outcome of a BatchDurable job.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) recordJob(jobID JobID, err error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	j := &t.mu.jobs
+	if j.results == nil {
+		j.results = make(map[JobID]error, durabilityJobRetention)
+		j.ring = make([]JobID, 0, durabilityJobRetention)
+		j.first = jobID
+	}
+	if len(j.ring) < durabilityJobRetention {
+		j.ring = append(j.ring, jobID)
+	} else {
+		evicted := j.ring[j.head]
+		delete(j.results, evicted)
+		j.maxEvicted = max(j.maxEvicted, evicted)
+		j.ring[j.head] = jobID
+		j.head = (j.head + 1) % durabilityJobRetention
+	}
+	j.results[jobID] = err
+}
+
+// jobResult returns the recorded outcome of the provided job.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) jobResult(jobID JobID) error {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	j := &t.mu.jobs
+	if jobID > 0 && j.results != nil {
+		if err, ok := j.results[jobID]; ok {
+			return err
+		}
+		if jobID >= j.first && jobID <= j.maxEvicted {
+			return errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobExpired, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+		}
+	}
+	return errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobUnknown, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+}
+
+// close unblocks all waiters with err and causes all future waits for
+// sequence numbers that are not yet durable to fail.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) close(err error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if t.mu.closeErr == nil {
+		t.mu.closeErr = err
+	}
+	res, _ := t.resultLocked(math.MaxUint64)
+	t.failAllLocked(res)
+}
+
+// subscribe registers a waiter for seqNum. If the outcome is already
+// determined, the returned waiter's channel is pre-filled and the waiter is
+// not registered.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) subscribe(seqNum base.SeqNum, notify bool) *durabilityWaiter {
+	w := &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: make(chan error, 1), notify: notify, index: -1}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if err, done := t.resultLocked(seqNum); done {
+		w.ch <- err
+		return w
+	}
+	if notify {
+		if t.mu.notifySubs >= maxDurabilityNotifySubscriptions {
+			w.ch <- errors.WithStack(ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions)
+			return w
+		}
+		t.mu.notifySubs++
+	}
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, w)
+	return w
+}
+
+// wait blocks until seqNum is durable, a durability error occurs, the DB is
+// closed, or ctx is done. Durability and close errors take precedence over
+// context cancellation.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) wait(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	w := t.subscribe(seqNum, false /* notify */)
+	// Fast path: the outcome was already determined.
+	select {
+	case err := <-w.ch:
+		return err
+	default:
+	}
+	t.pendingWaiters.Add(1)
+	defer t.pendingWaiters.Add(-1)
+	select {
+	case err := <-w.ch:
+		return err
+	case <-ctx.Done():
+	}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if w.index < 0 {
+		// The waiter was released concurrently with the cancellation; its
+		// outcome takes precedence.
+		return <-w.ch
+	}
+	heap.Remove(&t.mu.waiters, w.index)
+	w.index = -1
+	return ctx.Err()
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) stats() DurabilityStats {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return DurabilityStats{
+		HighestDurableSeqNum:   t.mu.durable,
+		FirstErr:               t.mu.firstErr,
+		PendingWaiters:         t.pendingWaiters.Load(),
+		TotalDurableCommits:    t.mu.totalDurable,
+		TotalFailedCommits:     t.mu.totalFailed,
+		CumulativeSyncDuration: t.mu.cumSync,
+		MaxSyncDuration:        t.mu.maxSync,
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) metrics() (count uint64, duration time.Duration) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return t.mu.metricsCount, t.mu.metricsDuration
+}
+
+// batchDurable reports the outcome of the WAL sync for a Sync commit of b. It
+// must be called exactly once per Sync commit, after the WAL sync completed.
+func (d *DB) batchDurable(b *Batch, err error) {
+	st := &b.durable
+	var syncDuration time.Duration
+	if st.walWritten != 0 {
+		syncDuration = st.walWritten.Elapsed()
+	}
+	applyDuration := st.applyDuration
+	if err == nil {
+		// Guarantee strictly positive durations for successful commits even
+		// with a coarse clock.
+		syncDuration = max(syncDuration, 1)
+		applyDuration = max(applyDuration, 1)
+	}
+	lastSeqNum := st.seqNum
+	if st.count > 0 {
+		lastSeqNum += base.SeqNum(st.count - 1)
+	}
+	d.durability.record(lastSeqNum, err, syncDuration, d.batchDurableEnabled)
+	if !d.batchDurableEnabled {
+		return
+	}
+	jobID := d.newJobID()
+	d.durability.recordJob(jobID, err)
+	d.opts.EventListener.BatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo{
+		JobID:         int(jobID),
+		SeqNum:        st.seqNum,
+		Err:           err,
+		ApplyDuration: applyDuration,
+		SyncDuration:  syncDuration,
+		CorrelationID: st.correlationID,
+		BatchSize:     st.size,
+		KeyCount:      st.count,
+	})
+}
+
+// WaitForDurability blocks until the provided sequence number is durable as a
+// result of a Sync commit. It returns an error if a WAL sync fails or the DB
+// is closed before the sequence number becomes durable. A zero sequence
+// number is always considered durable. If the WAL is disabled, it returns nil
+// immediately.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurability(seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(context.Background(), seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityContext is like WaitForDurability, but additionally
+// returns ctx.Err() if ctx is done before the outcome is determined.
+// Durability and close errors take precedence over context cancellation.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatch blocks until every provided sequence number is
+// durable. It returns nil immediately if seqNums is empty. See
+// WaitForDurability.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatch(seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(context.Background(), seqNums)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatchContext is like WaitForDurabilityBatch, but
+// additionally returns ctx.Err() if ctx is done before the outcome is
+// determined. Durability and close errors take precedence over context
+// cancellation.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(ctx context.Context, seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	if len(seqNums) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	// Durability is monotonic, so waiting for the largest sequence number
+	// suffices.
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, slices.Max(seqNums))
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurability returns the outcome of the BatchDurable event with the
+// provided job ID (BatchDurableInfo.JobID). Only the most recent events are
+// retained; older job IDs return an error wrapping ErrDurabilityJobExpired.
+// Job IDs that were never assigned to a BatchDurable event (including zero)
+// return an error wrapping ErrDurabilityJobUnknown. If the WAL is disabled,
+// it returns nil immediately.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurability(jobID int) error {
+	return d.WaitForJobDurabilityContext(context.Background(), jobID)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurabilityContext is like WaitForJobDurability. Job outcomes are
+// recorded before the BatchDurable event fires, so the outcome of any job ID
+// known to the caller is already determined and takes precedence over context
+// cancellation.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, jobID int) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return d.durability.jobResult(JobID(jobID))
+}
+
+// DurableState returns the highest sequence number known to be durable as a
+// result of a Sync commit and the first WAL sync error observed, if any.
+func (d *DB) DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+	return d.durability.mu.durable, d.durability.mu.firstErr
+}
+
+// DurabilityNotify returns a channel that receives exactly one value: nil once
+// seqNum is durable, or a non-nil error if a WAL sync fails or the DB is
+// closed first. The channel is buffered so the value is delivered even if the
+// caller never receives it. The number of outstanding subscriptions is
+// bounded; when the bound is exceeded the returned channel immediately
+// delivers an error wrapping ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions. If the WAL is
+// disabled, the channel immediately delivers nil.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityNotify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		ch := make(chan error, 1)
+		ch <- nil
+		return ch
+	}
+	return d.durability.subscribe(seqNum, true /* notify */).ch
+}
+
+// DurabilityStats returns a snapshot of the DB's durability tracking state.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats {
+	return d.durability.stats()
+}
